components.published_behavior: Gemini 3.6 Flash, Claude Code Opus 4.8
components.implementation: Configurable Grok/compatible defaults, independent critic panels, explicit frontier escalation, and typed Laya /v1/systemone advisory transport; cheap calls never remove stages. Opt-in Google Flash profile routes routine roles through the compatible API while retaining primary coding and scientific judgments, explicit overrides and frontier escalation. Laya shares vault/session credential resolution. Global model defaults inherit through workspace and canonical project overrides; explicit run configurations retain precedence. Managed SSH workspaces receive credential-free parent snapshots; stale writers are rejected using hierarchy-aware revisions. Specialist dispatch is isolated behind an explicit accounted-call interface; ordinary panel consensus and provider accounting remain in AgentRunner. Fresh inherited settings provide a compact compatible-model inventory; new runs compile locally configured eligible models into fixed role routes with cost-estimated routine selection. Project allowlists constrain the pool and native-writer/command boundaries; Laya remains separate. Partial settings writes preserve other preferences and old explicit configurations.
components.remaining_gap: Alternative models and coding harness require paired capability evaluation. Laya is advisory and non-generative; no configured endpoint availability is inferred. Google/Laya mixed-policy quality and end-to-end cost savings remain unmeasured; published token estimates are dated and need updating. Inheritance and SSH propagation are verified with local controller fixtures; live SSH deployments require the updated runtime and host-specific credentials/services. Inventory access is local configuration inspection, not provider/account entitlement verification or live model discovery. Automatic cost routing remains a deterministic unmeasured policy; it does not dynamically fail over existing runs.

components.remaining_gap: Live smoke retained Semantic Scholar throttling and a Crossref decoding failure plus successful recheck. Provider quotas/coverage and unavailable full text remain visible; recall is unmeasured.

components.published_behavior: 107 public scientific problems and external review/integrity evaluation

components.published_behavior: Long autonomous executions and research artifacts
components.implementation: GUI/TUI/CLI share private runs, scoped model settings, history, evidence inspection and explicit execution controls. New inquiries accept an objective, optional papers/project and one model budget including intake. The browser creates or selects host-side folders; PDF/text uploads carry private bytes to the controller. Agents establish commands, metrics and measurement after Start. Creation makes no model calls. Clarification is versioned and saving an answer does not resume. Separate AI preparation endpoints are retired with historical receipts read-only. Explicit imported configurations preserve compatibility; saved runs retain behavior drift protection. Managed SSH, model/Laya scopes, credential controls, charcoal/cream themes, responsive navigation and synthetic temple remain available. Execution is a normal browser inquiry step; GUI/TUI/CLI expose Docker, local and Slurm selection, backend differences and per-job CPU/memory/GPU settings. Local permission remains explicit. Interfaces distinguish controller location, serial within-run experiments, isolated source snapshots and separate manuscript execution. Deterministic stage exit reports preserve attempted checkpoints, failures, changed evidence and manuscript identities atomically; the main Research interface exposes readable reports with expandable records and stable selection.
components.remaining_gap: Agent-led autonomous capability and research quality are unmeasured. Live API, Docker/GPU/Slurm and remote deployment require environment-specific validation. Private resources need operator access; custom detached batch launchers and unsupported cluster layouts are not adopted. Model budgets do not cap unpriced compute or storage. Within-run experiments remain serial; overlapping runs have no shared resource admission quota. Private source snapshots are not Git worktrees. ScientistTwo publication does not establish its scheduling or filesystem isolation setup.

components.published_behavior: Paper coding, engineering, ablation and rebuttal agents inspect and execute repositories.
components.implementation: Bounded multi-step list/read/search/edit/command/finish tools persist observations, diffs, failures and checkpoints; command-created source exports explicitly, pilot outputs stay separate. Budget exhaustion identifies the preserved checkpoint and latest recorded failure with bounded, redacted diagnostics. Agent resource acquisition retains pinned repository revisions and raw data hashes, resumes materialization, and exports resources separately from text edits. Docker/Slurm GPU settings are recorded. Command ownership stays with coding agents in agent entry. Recent history is sized after privacy redaction and evidence projection; oversized observations expose indexed omissions and redacted JSON pages with original/view hashes. A pinned Ponytail-derived efficiency policy is available through an explicit new-run specification bundle; default instructions remain unchanged. Paired coding pilots retain all failures and independent acceptance receipts.
components.remaining_gap: Alternative harness capability versus Claude Code remains unmeasured. The 2026-10-01 Ponytail pilot completed no live task due to provider and structured-action failures; cost savings and output-quality equivalence remain unestablished.
